source.description: A jackal-headed raider with tan fur and a bronze shoulder plate, holding a curved khopesh sword, standing in a ready stance. Seamless loop.
The jackal-headed raider with the curved khopesh sword attacks — it draws the blade back across its body, then slashes it in a wide arc toward the camera, then returns to its ready fighting stance.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
